title: Taller houses, a working mill, cows
changes: Saltmere's fishers live in narrow two-storey houses now, doors open, nets drying on the walls and oars by the door.
Redfang Hollow's huts are tall dark-log barracks with war banners, spears and a bandit watching from each doorway.
Millbrook Mill has a big turning water wheel and a millstone room on pilings over the river.
Two cows graze in the Goldenreach barn.
